title: On the Unreasonable Effectiveness of Last-layer Retraining
reasoning: The paper investigates the effectiveness of Last-layer Retraining (LLR) in improving group robustness and mitigating biases from spurious correlations. While it utilizes datasets that include religion and other demographic identity markers for group-based performance metrics, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical frameworks as a core research component.
